scene.speaker: sofia
scene.bubble: New class rules, written by us! Rule one: we must help each other. Rule two: Luna must stay OUT of the lunch boxes.
scene.intro: New class rules, written by the students! Rule one: we must help each other. Rule two: we must listen when someone speaks. Rule three: we mustn't shout in the corridor. Sofía writes them on a big poster with beautiful letters, and Mateo adds rule four: we mustn't run — and then he runs to hang the poster. What rules have YOU got in your class?

activities.title: Listen to the rules meeting. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.script: Sofia: Class meeting! We are writing our ten rules. Mateo, write this down. … Mateo: Ready! My pencil is sharp. … Sofia: Rule one: we must help each other with difficult exercises. … Sofia: Rule two: we mustn't laugh at mistakes. Mistakes help us learn! … Mateo: Rule three: we must water the class plant every Monday. … Sofia: Good one! And rule four: we mustn't leave rubbish on the floor. … Mateo: And rule five, very important: Luna mustn't open the lunch boxes! … Sofia: Approved! Five more rules tomorrow.

data.text: Invent 3 rules for a crazy place (a dragon school, a pirate ship…): "You must… You mustn't…" Read them aloud — the class guesses the place!

homework.prompt: Write 4 rules of your home: two with must and two with mustn't. Do you follow them all? Be honest!

outcomes.puede: Understand short dialogues with more vocabulary; identify main information in simple announcements.
Describe routines, favourites, community helpers; give short opinions.
Read short paragraphs; answer simple comprehension Qs; find specific info.
